sections.heading: Check the source
sections.content: Reliable health information should identify who created it, cite medical review or evidence, explain its purpose, and separate education from advertising or sales.

sections.heading: Be cautious online
sections.content: Be cautious with miracle cures, pressure to buy products, claims that one treatment works for everyone, or advice that tells you to ignore licensed clinicians.

sections.heading: Use professional care
sections.content: Online information can support questions and self-care, but it should not replace diagnosis, treatment decisions, or emergency care from qualified professionals.
